column1: # startup_cost.tsv — exact setup-work pins for a 1-byte in-process compress.
# Cargo feature: anatomy-counters. These counters exist ONLY in that
# feature's build; the default (shipped) build compiles every call site to
# zero bytes and never reads this file.
# A 1-byte input makes per-byte work ~zero, so every value below is
# per-invocation FIXED cost: table builds, buffer allocation, T>1 pool
# spin-up and seam framing. This is the laptop-visible proxy for the
# ~6.2 ms invocation floor that T>1 wall verdicts carry — an init-cost
# regression moves these counts BEFORE it erodes every wall cell at once.
# Grid: 1-byte input x levels {1, 6, 9} x threads {1, 4}. T1 = production
# single-member entry (encode_gzip_bytes_to_vec); T4 = library route into
# PipelinedGzEncoder, the sole production T>1 path. T4 determinism is
# enforced by a double-run guard on every run (1 byte = single chunk on a
# single worker; no counter was racy at pin generation).
# Counts catch CHANGES; they do not price them. A pin diff names the
# mechanism; the wall verdict still needs paired runs on the frozen box.
# Regenerate (the diff is the change's mechanism — commit it in the same PR):
